fact: The ICT Authority Government Cloud Computing Standard ICTA-8.003:2023, approved 3 May 2023 and effective 1 July 2023, requires ministry, department and agency data to be stored and processed within Kenya and cloud contracts to carry an exit plan and a data-location clause.
title: Government ICT Standards: Cloud Computing Standard ICTA-8.003:2023
why_not: off-topic: dated 2023-05-03, before the three-year window; the cloud policy of 2024 is selected instead
